contribution_requirements_justification: Contribution guidelines, coding standards, and test requirements are documented in https://github.com/Gaardsholt/pass-along/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md
english_justification: All project documentation, code comments, commit messages, issues, and discussions are written in English.
report_url_justification: Defects and enhancements are tracked via GitHub issues at https://github.com/Gaardsholt/pass-along/issues
report_tracker_justification: GitHub Issues is used as the issue tracker for bugs and feature requests: https://github.com/Gaardsholt/pass-along/issues
report_process_justification: Bug reports are submitted and tracked via GitHub Issues at https://github.com/Gaardsholt/pass-along/issues as described in the contributing guidelines.
report_responses_justification: The maintainer actively responds to all submitted bug reports and discussions on GitHub.
enhancement_responses_justification: The maintainer responds to enhancement requests and pull requests submitted via GitHub.
report_archive_justification: All issues, discussions, and pull requests are publicly archived and searchable on GitHub at https://github.com/Gaardsholt/pass-along/issues
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: A documented vulnerability reporting policy is published in https://github.com/Gaardsholt/pass-along/blob/master/SECURITY.md
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: Private vulnerability reports are accepted via GitHub Security Advisories and direct email to the maintainer as documented in https://github.com/Gaardsholt/pass-along/blob/master/SECURITY.md
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerabilities were reported in the last 6 months. A response within 14 days is committed to in SECURITY.md.
build_justification: The project can be built using standard Go commands ('go build') and Docker ('docker build').
build_common_tools_justification: The build relies on standard Go tooling (go compiler and go modules) and standard Docker containers.
build_floss_tools_justification: The software is completely built with FLOSS tools: Go compiler and Docker.
test_justification: The automated test suite is written using Go standard testing library and fuzzing, run via GitHub Actions: https://github.com/Gaardsholt/pass-along/blob/master/.github/workflows/go_test.yml
test_invocation_justification: Tests are invoked using standard Go testing commands ('go test ./...') as documented in CONTRIBUTING.md.
test_most_justification: The automated test suite covers unit tests and fuzzing for encryption, decryption, API endpoints, config, redis, and datastores.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: Continuous integration is implemented using GitHub Actions workflows running unit tests, fuzzing, and linting on every pull request.
test_policy_justification: The project policy requires unit or fuzz tests for all new functionality or bug fixes.
tests_are_added_justification: Recent major additions such as fuzz testing and datastore support have been accompanied by unit and fuzz test suites.
tests_documented_added_justification: Testing policy and instructions for adding tests to pull requests are documented in https://github.com/Gaardsholt/pass-along/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md
warnings_justification: The project enables compiler checks with Go and uses golangci-lint via GitHub Actions: https://github.com/Gaardsholt/pass-along/blob/master/.github/workflows/go_test.yml
warnings_fixed_justification: golangci-lint is strictly enforced on pull requests and commits, and all flagged warnings are addressed.
warnings_strict_justification: Linting is run in CI with golangci-lint and reviewdog to enforce strict clean builds without warnings.
know_secure_design_justification: The primary maintainer is knowledgeable in secure design principles, implementing least privilege, fail-safe defaults, input validation, and authenticated encryption.
know_common_errors_justification: The primary maintainer understands common vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, CWE Top 25) such as injection, memory safety errors, and cryptographic flaws, mitigating them through type safety, input validation, and secure cryptographic primitives.
crypto_published_justification: The software uses published, standardized algorithms: AES-256-GCM for symmetric encryption and PBKDF2 with SHA-512 for key derivation.
crypto_call_justification: The project uses Go standard library cryptographic packages (crypto/aes, crypto/cipher, crypto/rand, crypto/pbkdf2, crypto/sha512) and does not re-implement cryptography.
crypto_floss_justification: All cryptographic functionality is implemented using the FLOSS standard Go runtime library.
crypto_keylength_justification: AES-256 (256-bit symmetric key) and SHA-512 (512-bit hash) are used, exceeding NIST minimum requirements through 2030.
crypto_working_justification: No broken algorithms or insecure modes (such as MD5, DES, or ECB) are used. AES in GCM mode is used to guarantee confidentiality and authenticity.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: The implementation does not use algorithms or modes with known serious weaknesses such as SHA-1 or CBC mode.
crypto_pfs_justification: The application does not implement key exchange or long-term session key agreements. It encrypts transient payloads with random nonces. Network transport security is provided by upstream TLS.
crypto_password_storage_justification: The software does not store user passwords for authentication of external users.
crypto_random_justification: All cryptographic nonces and random values are generated using the cryptographically secure random number generator crypto/rand.Reader: https://github.com/Gaardsholt/pass-along/blob/master/crypto/encrypt.go
delivery_unsigned_justification: No unverified cryptographic hashes are downloaded or used over insecure plain HTTP channels.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: There are no unpatched vulnerabilities of medium or higher severity publicly known for more than 60 days.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: The project policy commits to rapid remediation of critical vulnerabilities when identified.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: The repository is scanned and contains no valid private credentials, secrets, or API keys.
static_analysis_justification: Static analysis is performed using GitHub CodeQL and golangci-lint on every pull request and push: https://github.com/Gaardsholt/pass-along/blob/master/.github/workflows/codeql.yml
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: GitHub CodeQL rules specifically scan for common security vulnerabilities (e.g. CWE Top 25, OWASP Top 10) in Go and JavaScript code.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: All medium and higher severity issues detected by CodeQL or linters are resolved before changes are merged.
static_analysis_often_justification: Static analysis runs automatically via GitHub Actions on every pull request and on weekly scheduled scans.
dynamic_analysis_justification: Automated fuzz testing (Go native fuzzing) runs continuously in CI on each pull request covering the crypto and API packages.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: The software is written entirely in Go, which is a memory-safe language, and does not contain C or C++ code.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Tests run with test assertions, data bounds validations, and race detection enabled during test runs.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: No vulnerabilities have been discovered via dynamic analysis; any discovered issues will be fixed immediately.
